meta.name: hook-setup
meta.description: Inspect and install CCAM monitoring hooks for Claude Code and Codex. Use when onboarding a provider, repairing missing hooks, checking which provider is active, or validating that installation preserved unrelated user hooks.

copy.tagline: 检查并安装 Claude Code 与 Codex 的监控钩子
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要为 Claude Code 或 Codex 安装或修复监控钩子。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and install monitoring hooks for Claude Code and Codex
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code or Codex and need to set up or fix their monitoring hooks.

howto.what: 当用户要求时,检查并安装CCAM监控钩子:先显示当前钩子状态,标明缺失或被替换的钩子,经确认后安装所选provider的钩子,再复查并启动真实会话验证事件是否到达CCAM。
howto.when: 当用户要接入新provider、修复缺失钩子、检查当前激活的provider等时触发。

say.text: 检查一下当前CCAM钩子的状态
say.note: 会显示哪些provider钩子缺失或将被替换
需要先确认provider范围,再执行安装

say.text: 验证钩子安装是否保留了其他用户钩子
say.note: 安装只替换CCAM拥有的条目

howto.what_en: When requested, inspects and installs CCAM monitoring hooks: first shows current hook status, identifies missing or to-be-replaced hooks, after confirmation installs hooks for selected providers, re-checks status, and starts a real session to verify events reach CCAM.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to onboard a new provider, repair missing hooks, check which provider is active, or verify installation preserved unrelated hooks.

say_en.text: Check the current CCAM hook status.
say_en.note: Shows which provider hooks are missing or will be replaced.
Confirm provider scope first, then install.

say_en.text: Verify hook installation preserved other user hooks.
